# Subtask mapping (pointer)

The mapping from graph node kinds to subtask prefixes (`[BE]`, `[DB]`, `[INT]`, `[FE]`, `[TEST]`, `[DOC]`) is owned by
the `code-graph` skill and lives at `.github/skills/code-graph/references/subtask-mapping.md`. Read that file; this
pointer exists so that a search under `jira-work-items/references/` finds it.
